name: Beat Lamp
description:
Audio-reactive concert lighting, stage effects, and redstone signals synced to jukebox music in real time.

Features:
- Beat Lamp: 6 reactive modes (Pulse, RGB, Spectrum, Ripple, Wave, Scan), 16 dye colors + OLED rainbow, frameless styling, and particle effects.
- Stage Light: 5 concert lighting modes (Sweep, Beat Step, Static, Strobe, Chase) with dual-layer atmospheric beams and beat color cycles.
- Beat Fountain: Stage pyro jets, customizable drop thresholds, smoke control, 7 particle styles, and real fireworks launches.
- Beat Emitter: Redstone power (0-15) and beat pulse clocks dynamically driven by music.
- Group Linker: Fast 2-corner area linking tool for multi-fixture synchronization.
- Lamp Controller: Direct GUI configuration and Jukebox audio source binding.
